name: DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds
title: DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds
summary: DetourBench constrains environments to compute minimum action counts and residual work, enabling separate evaluation of language-model agents' success, attainment, and detour beyond endpoint scoring.
